metadata.method_name: SAM vs SGD test-accuracy comparison (Fashion-MNIST, small CNN)
metadata.title: Does SAM beat SGD on test accuracy?

config.validation_split: 5,000 of the 60,000 training images (permutation, generator seed 1234)
config.augmentation: RandomCrop(28, padding=2) on training batches only; no flips
config.sam: non-adaptive SAM (Foret et al. 2021), BN momentum 0 in the second pass

bootstrap.scope: test-sampling noise only; training-seed variance is in the seed-level summary

tuning.selection_rule: lowest final-epoch validation NLL on the 5,000-image validation split, seed 0

timings.note: MPS timings with a shared GPU; the first epoch of each run includes warm-up, so per-epoch means are averages over all epochs of each run.

deviations_from_plan: Three seeds only (plan's default). Seeds 3 and 4 were not added.
SAM_30 and SGD_30 are compared per epoch, not per gradient budget; the matched-budget reading is SGD_60.
The shifted-test set was not generated (no calibration metrics), as the plan specifies.
Test accuracy, NLL and Brier score are computed once per model on final-epoch weights.
